seoTitle: CCSD Calendar 2026–2027: School Dates, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: See Clark County School District’s 2026–27 student calendar, including the first and last days of school, holidays, no-school days, winter and spring break, plus the official PDF and an ICS calendar download.
heroSummary:
Clark County School District begins the 2026–27 school year on Monday, August 10, 2026, and the scheduled last day of school is Thursday, May 20, 2027. Students are off for Winter Break December 21–January 1 and Spring Break March 15–19.

Classes resume January 5 after a staff development day on January 4, and students return from Spring Break on March 22.

customSections.label: What CCSD Families Should Know
customSections.content: Four details on the student calendar can affect family plans.

groups.label: Staff development
items: Students do not attend on Sept. 21, Nov. 3, Jan. 4 or March 29.

groups.label: Elementary conferences
items: Oct. 12 is a no-school day for elementary students only; middle and high school families should follow their school schedule.

groups.label: Contingency dates
items: Nov. 25, March 26 and May 21 are reserved dates that CCSD may use if instructional time must be recovered.

groups.label: Break timing
items: Winter and Spring Break begin after school on Dec. 18 and March 12; the actual no-school ranges begin the following Monday.

whatsNew.title: What’s Different From 2025–26
whatsNew.subtitle: Changes between the official CCSD student calendars for the two school years.
content: The first day moves from Aug. 11, 2025 to Aug. 10, 2026.
The scheduled last day moves from May 22, 2026 to May 20, 2027.
The Spring Break no-school week moves from March 16–20, 2026 to March 15–19, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When does CCSD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Classes begin Monday, Aug. 10, 2026 on the CCSD student calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCSD Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Students have no school Dec. 21, 2026 through Jan. 1, 2027. Jan. 4 is a staff development day, and classes resume Tuesday, Jan. 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCSD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Students have no school March 15–19, 2027. Classes resume Monday, March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CCSD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day is Thursday, May 20, 2027. CCSD also lists May 21 as a contingency date if needed.

calendarFaqs.q: Are CCSD staff development days school days for students?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Students do not attend on the staff development days listed on the student calendar.
Contingency days are reserved dates that may become instructional days if CCSD needs to recover school time. Do not treat them as guaranteed holidays until the district confirms the schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Does this calendar apply to every CCSD school?
calendarFaqs.a: It follows CCSD’s district Student Calendar. Schools using a year-round or separate program schedule may have different dates, and every school may publish additional campus events.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I find the Spanish CCSD calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official Spanish student-calendar PDF in the Other CCSD Calendars and Languages section above.
